recommendedActions: [Gaming-P1] Escalate immediately to fraud-ops + AML leadership; suspend wallet funding, bonus issuance, and withdrawals until a named analyst clears the case.
[Gaming-P1] Preserve full case evidence for 30 days (session_id, device_fingerprint, ip_asn, payment_rail, chargeback_id, rg_intervention_history) for investigation and regulator requests.
[Gaming-P1] Block automated payouts above policy threshold and require dual-approval on any manual override; attach correlation_id to the case file.

[Fraud] Pull chargeback_history_90d, disputed_deposits_90d, payment_rail_mix, and linked_account_ids; run device_fingerprint overlap and shared-IP / shared-bank clustering before releasing any high-value payout.

[Bonus] Inspect rollover_progress, active_bonus_ids, promo_redemptions_30d, sticky_balance vs cashable_balance, and linked_account_ids; validate device_fingerprint and behavioural overlap against gnoming / chip_dump_pattern before releasing sticky funds.

[Velocity] Compare session_length, bet_velocity_7d, stake_ramp, loss_chase_index, and tilt_proxy against cohort baselines; apply cooling_off or deposit_cap when z-score sustains above threshold for 48h.
[Gaming-Identity] Reconcile aliases against kyc_docs, alias_reconciliation_status, and linked_account_ids before large withdrawals or account merges.

- Name/alias coherence 0.3625 (weight 0.5): mean Jaccard 0.1250, mean Levenshtein-normalized 0.6000.

- AttributeSignals 0.5500 (weight 0.25): No nationality/DOB-style attributeSignals detected; base attribute component 0.55.
- Confidence prior 0.9000 (weight 0.25) from entity.confidence.score.

Conflict rule: alias pairs with combined similarity < 0.40 (strategy-adjusted).
Conflicts: 1 low-similarity alias(es) flagged; canonical displayName retained. Correlation: 0c5a26c7-4f0f-47fe-abab-27d689c7e128.

components.justification: Scrutinize payment reversals, account-takeover markers, stolen-instrument disputes, and collusion across linked accounts before approving large deposits, withdrawals, or account merges. Drivers: Payment or account-integrity red flags (chargebacks, disputes, or collusion patterns). Score=0.6601 (base 0.295 + signal 0.365). Confidence=0.8837 biasFlag=true.

Review bonus rollover progress, linked-account chains, and staking patterns for coordinated abuse (gnoming, chip-dumping, promo farming) before releasing sticky or restricted bonus funds. Drivers: Promotional or bonus-integrity abuse indicators (rollover, syndicate, or farming patterns). Identity inconsistency increases bonus-eligibility review priority. Score=0.6959 (base 0.295 + signal 0.401). Confidence=0.8645 biasFlag=true.

Compare stake velocity, session clustering, and loss-chasing proxies to cohort baselines; escalate friction or cooling-off when deviations persist across consecutive session windows. Drivers: Behavioral stress: velocity, session clustering, or cohort deviation signals. Score=0.6253 (base 0.295 + signal 0.330). Confidence=0.8452 biasFlag=true.

Confirm KYC strength, PEP / sanctions alignment, and source-of-funds plausibility when payout tier or jurisdiction triggers CDD; escalate to EDD when regulatory signals stack. Drivers: AML/KYC or source-of-funds markers detected. Missing DOB increases KYC uncertainty. Unknown nationality increases screening risk. Score=0.6151 (base 0.295 + signal 0.320). Confidence=0.8933 biasFlag=true.

Validate limit breaches, self-exclusion status, cooling-off flags, and CRM intervention triggers before outbound promos, limit increases, or high-value payouts. Drivers: RG policy stress: limits, self-exclusion, or intervention triggers. Score=0.5316 (base 0.295 + signal 0.237). Confidence=0.8548 biasFlag=true.

Vet PSP / aggregator certification, integration incident history, and contractual controls before routing high-value rails or authorizing new KYC, data, or payment partners. Drivers: Third-party / PSP / platform integration exposure indicators. Score=0.4993 (base 0.295 + signal 0.204). Confidence=0.8164 biasFlag=true.
